name: Fleet & Infrastructure Renewal — Keolis Valmont
business_need: Support capital renewal decisions on the Réseau Valmo operating contract (DSP-VM-2021): which projects need intervention this week, what their full financial exposure is from the operator's and the authority's perspectives, and whether approved work is ready to proceed without undermining service. Connect asset condition and project delivery to service requirements, contractual responsibility, financial exposure and exact source evidence, and keep a reported issue, an approved decision, a posted cost and a realised outcome apart.

personas.name: Operating Company Executive
personas.description: Asks which projects need a decision this week, what the full exposure is, and whether approved work is ready.

personas.name: Investment Controller
personas.description: Asks whether forecasts reconcile, what moved and why, and what sits outside the authorised scope.

personas.name: Rolling Stock Maintenance Lead
personas.description: Asks which assets need renewal, what is really accepted, and where failures concentrate.

personas.name: Infrastructure Project Manager
personas.description: Asks whether works can start, what they depend on, and what has changed in scope.

personas.name: Commercial & Contract Manager
personas.description: Asks who pays, which clause applies, which amendment changed it, and whether notice was given.

metrics.name: Forecast Total Project Cost
metrics.description: Forecast_Total = [Posted actuals] + [Valid uninvoiced accruals] + [Forecast cost to complete].

metrics.name: Forecast Cost to Complete
metrics.description: CTC = [Remaining committed work] + [Expected uncommitted work] + [Contingency held separately].

metrics.name: Open Commitment
metrics.description: Open_Commitment = [Ordered] − [Received] − [Cancelled], at the PO line's valuation basis.

metrics.name: Approved Funding Gap
metrics.description: Funding_Gap = [Forecast fundable expenditure] − [Applicable approved funding], applying scope, caps and co-funding; uncovered costs labelled separately..

metrics.name: Operator Exposure
metrics.description: Operator_Exposure = Σ costs borne by Keolis Valmont under validated allocations, with unresolved-exposure scenarios shown separately.

metrics.name: Service Availability Margin
metrics.description: Margin = [Eligible available vehicles] − [Peak requirement] − [Agreed reserve], by class, location and time; each unavailable vehicle subtracted once..

metrics.name: Failure Frequency
metrics.description: Failure_Frequency = [Relevant failures] ÷ [Distance] × 100,000, with a consistent failure taxonomy and peer group..

metrics.name: Schedule Variance
metrics.description: Schedule_Variance = [Current forecast milestone date] − [Approved baseline milestone date], on the working calendar; approved re-baselining identified..

hero_questions.text: Which renewal projects need intervention this week, and why?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT p.project_code, p.project_name, p.stage, s.task_name, s.baseline_finish, s.current_finish
FROM `ppm`.`project` p
JOIN `ppm`.`schedule_task` s ON s.project_code = p.project_code
WHERE s.current_finish > s.baseline_finish
LIMIT 1000

hero_questions.text: What is our full financial exposure on the renewal portfolio?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT b.project_code, SUM(b.amount_eur) AS approved_eur
FROM `fin`.`budget_line` b
GROUP BY b.project_code
LIMIT 1000

hero_questions.text: Is the approved work ready to proceed without undermining service?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT a.access_ref, a.segment_id, a.window_start, a.status, a.substitution_buses
FROM `ops`.`access_window` a
WHERE a.status <> 'Approved'
LIMIT 1000

hero_questions.text: Who pays for the BUS-204 engine repair?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT r.asset_scope, r.role, r.party, r.clause_ref, r.valid_from, r.valid_to, r.conditions
FROM `contract`.`responsibility_assignment` r
WHERE r.asset_scope LIKE 'BUS-20%'
LIMIT 1000

hero_questions.text: Is the battery replacement campaign complete?
hero_questions.sql:
SELECT a.result, COUNT(*) AS items
FROM `ppm`.`acceptance_item` a
WHERE a.project_code = 'P-VM-031'
GROUP BY a.result
LIMIT 1000
